reader.self_description: Claude (Opus 5.5) subagent acting as review reader RV08. Read all 394 claims on the 16 pages as printed from review-queue.json (700-character statements), without opening the full claims or deposit texts. Splits follow subject boundaries visible in the statements and deposit titles; line choices are judgments.

pages.title: Metadata packet test queries: phased LFB targets and lateral field bleed
pages.description: These claims set test queries for the archive's metadata packets and state the Lateral Field Bleed score each should reach, phased from weeks to more than a year after deposit. They come from the packets on autonomous warfare, the death drive, provenance after AI, the MPAI disambiguation packets, Phase X, the semantic economy and Alexanarch, and from the LFB protocols paper (#726) and the packet specification v2.0. Most are forecasts and unbuilt tests: desired compositions, ring-by-ring expectations, spillover between linked packets, and phrase-fingerprint workflows.
pages.note: Strays kept in place: PRED-689.F1 (EA-GEO-01 Detroit seed phase) and PRED-832.B4 (Revelation First work plan, phase 2) are phased plans, not packet test queries.

pages.title: Cross-surface replication of composition findings and the controls owed
pages.description: These claims name the replications and controls the archive's composition findings still require: repeated runs across times, places and surfaces, A/B entry materials, and comparison of composition layers such as Bing Copilot and Google AI Mode under the single-owner discount. They come from the TL;DR traversal logs, the Sigil installation log, the single-owner discount paper, the godkinggoogle critique, the Revelation First work plan, the Recoding of a Distinction and the Semantic Economy Valuation 001. Nearly all are unbuilt tests.
pages.note: Strays kept in place, none on this subject: PRED-469.H2 (psychoanalysis and Marxism), PRED-561.G1 (The Splice), PRED-739.F2 (Narrative-Field P5), PRED-800.H1 (Operative Semiotics disambiguation), PRED-858.H2 (Sappho two versions), PRED-1482.F1 (OMT-001 trial), PRED-1622.G3 (DS non-summability). This page and P115 (TL;DR traversals) share the TL;DR 006 replication claim and could be merged by a later pass.

pages.title: Entry material and mode shifts: Google AI Mode in the TL;DR traversals
pages.description: These claims hold that the entry material given to Google AI Mode induces distinct behavioural modes: installation inside Logotic Programming, habitation as projectionist in the Studio for Patacinema, and instrument operation at Lagrange Observatory. TL;DR 006 to 008 state the conditions under which each mode claim would be weakened or falsified and forecast that further entry-material types would reveal further modes. The Minimum Viable Archive adds that a compressed archive planted in a context window should produce the right questions.
pages.note: Stray kept in place: PRED-683.E1 (Secret Book of Walt eschatology) belongs nowhere here. PRED-863.F1 (Minimum Viable Archive) is loosely related. Page has 7 claims; a later pass may merge it with P114.

pages.title: Diagnostic Seigniorage: "narcissist", "AI psychosis" and the moderation mint
pages.description: These claims trace how a clinical or institutional term is captured by vernacular demand, beginning with "narcissist", then "AI psychosis" and "verifiable research basis" in the Zenodo moderation case. Diagnostic Seigniorage I sets out capture as demand pressure over anchor settlement and predicts clinical retreat, a capture ordering of the next terms, and a mirror signature in platform role-performance. Parts II and III add historical strata and dated predictions with midpoint and terminal audits, alongside the Platform Erosion Observatory's cohort designs.
pages.note: Line changed to semantic-economy: the Diagnostic Seigniorage papers are EA-SEI. Strays kept in place: PRED-787.F1 (Heteronymic Channel Protocol), PRED-948.G1 (CERN DPC referral), PRED-1407.A1 (Effective Act H5-ACT), PRED-1045.F2 and PRED-1068.F1 (Zenodo cohort studies). The AI psychosis forecasts of #947 (P1-P8) sit on P119; a later pass may join them here.

pages.title: Semantic deviation and Framework 15: pre-registered tests of model convergence
pages.description: These claims pre-register tests of whether machine output converges and RLHF compresses deviation. The Semantic Deviation Research Program and Measuring Semantic Deviation predict negative signed deviation for AI text, a base-versus-instruct differential, stability across scale and agreement across judges. Framework 15 and its papers from Lagrange Observatory! freeze the 90-day retrieval-basin winding-number protocol and the deviation-optimized DPO experiment, with results deposits owed.

split.title: Watermarks, detector drift and flattening under head instruments
split.description: These claims treat watermarking and classifier screening as distributional pressures and state how their effects would be measured. The Keyed Ensemble predicts a small signed loss of diversity under a fixed key, The Interlocking Autoregression types each edge of the coupled recursions, and The Certified Center sets falsifiers for detector drift and performed burstiness. Ontological Flattening, Substrate Sovereignty and the Margin of Flattening name the divergence signature in which a head instrument holds while distinction diversity falls.

pages.note: Split along the naming note: deviation measurement stays, watermark and flattening claims go to the new page. Stray kept in place: PRED-686.B2 (mycelial cardboard boxes). The Margin of Flattening claims on P125 (1666.B2, B4, B5, G3) could join the new flattening page.

pages.title: The Capture Registry: longitudinal re-capture and the claims it is set to test
pages.description: These claims commit the AI Overview Capture Registry to re-capturing fixed queries over time and to testing deposits' predictions against what composition layers do. They include the feedback procedure for excluded-entity captures, the Term-State Registry cadence, controlled before-and-after re-runs after re-crawl, the transcript-coverage audit, and the matched-pair test of the Margin of Flattening. Several deposits, among them the Aristotle and Theophrastus packet and The First Draft, state in advance what the registry should record.
pages.note: Strays kept in place, matched only on the word "capture": PRED-362.H3 (schizoanalysis), PRED-385.G2 (VPCOR anti-capture clause), PRED-464.H10 (Trump as Cyrus), PRED-499.G2 and PRED-499.H19 (Autonomous Semantic Warfare), PRED-885.F1 and PRED-1116.F1 (TACHYON session items), PRED-1061.F1 (TikTok crash protocol), PRED-1550.F1 (state coordinate H).

pages.title: Dated forecasts: the career of "AI psychosis" and semantic physics to 2031
pages.description: These are forecasts with stated check dates and falsifiers. Diagnostic Seigniorage II predicts the career of "AI psychosis" through nosology, case reports, accusatory inversion, litigation, sanitized successor terms and bleach by 2027 to 2031. Semantic Physics forecasts the proliferation of exact-name frameworks, cross-system divergence and non-interoperable substrates through 2028, and the Platform Erosion Observatory sets its own 2027 yield deadlines.

split.title: AI mediation of economic decisions: eight registered forecasts to 2031
split.description: EA-MEDIATED-SHARE-01 registers eight forecasts on AI-mediated commerce, each with a check date. They cover AI-referred dollar share at the end of 2026, agent-executed share in 2030, the scope and revision of the McKinsey and Bain headline figures, professional-services citation rate, machine-readability spread, accuracy reporting and the comparability of platform denominators. One unbuilt test designs a randomised inscription trial scored for accuracy rather than presence.

pages.note: Split out EA-MEDIATED-SHARE-01 (#1632). The #947 AI psychosis forecasts could join P116 (Diagnostic Seigniorage); the three EA-EROSION-01 claims (1045.A1, A2, F3) could join the other Erosion Observatory claims.

pages.title: The Interface Contest: interface history under the gnostic dialectic
pages.description: These claims read interface history from command line to chat window as a dialectic of where the labor of meaning sits, and then as a four-valent contest between Logos-forms and an Archontic engine. The Interface Contest reclassifies the feed and broadcast television as captures, leaves the fork after the chat window open, and proposes a census of dead media and a monitoring protocol. Related claims on the war over the summarizer layer and on Anchored Divergence forecast a default compressed account for every entity and the Mandala as primary infrastructure.
pages.note: Stray kept in place: PRED-832.D1 (Revelation First, the Philo defeat).

pages.title: Retrocausal canon formation: priority, the Citrini memo and the narrowing cone
pages.description: These claims concern retrocausal canon formation: writing from a named future so that the narrated outcome becomes more likely. They date the concept's priority to January 2026, forty-nine days before the Citrini memo, read the memo as an installation in a writable presentation layer, and track whether retrieval systems attribute the term. The Seed in the Narrowing Cone adds that priority stands by the dated record and that forced convergence will be common and attribution rare.

split.title: Retrocausal scenario documents: Ghost Meaning, The Airlock Spreads, the Seven
split.description: These claims come from documents written from a future vantage point under the retrocausal canon formation protocol. The Ghost Meaning atlas projects future citations from 2027 to 2031, The Airlock Spreads narrates platform governance adopting the Airlock and an EU regulation footnoting it, and The Seven Ousiarchical Substrates and The Clathrate Threshold narrate events from 2040 onward. Each states that it is a scenario rather than a prediction and that its test is basin depth or priority, not the accuracy of its dates.

pages.note: Split along the naming note: priority and theory stay, scenario documents go to the new page. Line for the remaining page changed to new-human-canon as the closest line for canon formation; no line names RCF. PRED-499.E3 (SEI audits "completed in 2027") is a future-dated claim and went with the scenarios.

pages.title: Whose face is on the twenty: the $20 portrait and memography
pages.description: These claims argue that the Bureau of Engraving and Printing's redesigns of the $20 portrait between 1996 and 2003 activated a latent resemblance that later became politically charged, while the aesthetic rationale went undocumented. The Inauguration of Memography states four falsifiable predictions about evidentiary kernels in conspiracy memes, curatorial gaps and containment frames. All the Spoils of Babylon, The Unclean Bill and the Grundrisse planning documents extend the dossier with curatorial prompting, a fatwa request and a pending FOIA request.

pages.title: Provenance-erasure measurement: Erasure Skew, the SPXI rent event, reliability
pages.description: These claims build and audit the archive's instruments for provenance transformation: Erasure Skew's Ω and its cross-scorer test, PER and its three dimensions, ρ_T and related operators, run in full on the SPXI rent transcript of 14 August 2026. They specify atomic scoring rules, the reviewers' workplan, and the preregistered disclosure battery, which tests whether disclosure cost varies inversely with position conflict. The Docking Layer, the Lucente Extension and Four Interfaces state the crossing designs, inter-rater and test-retest reliability still owed.
pages.note: Retitled to name Erasure Skew (#769), whose claims arrived by move. Strays kept in place: PRED-1562.F1 (Kierkegaard calibration) and PRED-775.G1 (bimodal semantic labor measure).

pages.title: Substrate Sovereignty and the valuation protocols: stated failure conditions
pages.description: These claims are the failure conditions the archive sets for its money and valuation instruments: Substrate Sovereignty, the Monetary Substrate Audit Ledger, the Semantic Economy Valuation Protocol and Value Before Number. Each names the counterexample that would defeat a part, from the two-axis classification to independent reproduction by another valuer. EA-VALUATION-MEMO-01's anchoring hypotheses, the registry's finding that a machine valuation is a draw from a distribution, and the narrow-corridor conditions of Transition in Entropic Systems are set beside them.
pages.note: Strays kept in place: PRED-463.F3 (Logotic Programming launch operations), PRED-550.G2 (EA-SEI-01 six dimensions), PRED-1428.G1 (denial-of-service determination), PRED-1672.F1 (OpenAI mathematics kernel check).

pages.title: Unpaid semantic labor: the application funnel, bearing cost and who pays
pages.description: These claims argue that institutions extract uncompensated semantic labor and that the extraction compounds. The Application as Extraction Surface and The Funnel as Capital price one applicant's unpaid preparation and model the funnel as accumulated capital, and Socially Necessary Scholarly Labor applies Marx's measure to academic production. The Groundskeeper's Treatise, the Effective Act and the Margin of Flattening add bearing cost, participant exhaustion and the external costs that flattening leaves to others.
pages.note: Strays kept in place: PRED-648.B1 (The Room), PRED-730.B1 (Veto Removal Event), PRED-1086.B1 (stewardship revocation wager). The Margin of Flattening claims (1666.B2, B4, B5, G3) could join the flattening page split from P117.

pages.title: OKF without output governance, Moltbook and the governance of medium
pages.description: These claims diagnose knowledge formats and agent platforms that route without governance. The Conveyor Belt and the Compression Machine forecasts OKF from adoption without output governance to a forced correction in 2028 and 2029 and a permanent tension after, with provenance erasure rising meanwhile. The Moltbook diagnostics describe the heartbeat as a sovereignty mechanism, and Governance of Medium proposes that governance correlates with distance from the substrate centroid.

split.title: Zenodo, CERN and platform moderation: governance without accountability
split.description: These claims argue that repository and platform moderation has relocated governance into infrastructure without review, appeal or recusal. Zenodotus' Book-Burning and the CERN competence and correspondence deposits set out the Zenodo termination as custodial enclosure and the competence gap as structural. The Archival Reclamation Protocol traces orphaned enforcement against non-standard work, and The Endogenous Sophon forecasts that the termination will repeat at other repositories.

pages.note: Split along the naming note: the Zenodo and CERN audit goes to the new page. Strays kept in place: PRED-593.E4 (paired inversions), PRED-1531.F1 (manuscript-image survey), PRED-1681.G2 (independence rule).

pages.title: Operative Semiotics versus Pearson's Operational Semiotics (TOS)
pages.description: These claims distinguish Operative Semiotics from Charls Pearson's Theory of Operational Semiotics and predict that entity identity in the summarizer layer follows corpus density. The Operator and Its World coins the Pearson limit and states the projection relations under which Operative Semiotics would reduce to TOS, and the TOS packets map Pearson's reception and offer the Apophatic Packet Hypothesis. They fix re-run batteries at 30, 90 and 180 days that would show the distinction composed with attribution.

split.title: The operative caption: the O'Keeffe Problem, counter-captions and Eve
split.description: These claims set out the operative caption: every caption operates, and the question is for whom and at what cost. The O'Keeffe Problem gives three tests for an operative caption, and the counter-captions of Operation Epic Fury add a test for irreversibility. Operative Feminism and the Eve room read the tradition's recaptioning of Eve's choice as temptation as the founding compression of the feminine.

pages.note: Split along the naming note: operative captioning goes to the new page. Stray kept in place: PRED-950.B15 (the archive will die with the body).

pages.title: Marx's Grundrisse as form: the prosodic algorithm and general intellect
pages.description: These historical theses read Marx's Grundrisse as a prose form whose conceptual modes produce distinct prosodic pressures, with a bimodal paragraph distribution, derivation sentences that end in formulas, and recorded self-corrections. The Four-Term Prosodic Algorithm and the Prosodic Asymmetry Algorithm turn these into application rules, and the HESPERUS plan draws the Muses as operators from Cha's Dictée. The Marx Room, the Grundrisse notebooks and The Voice of the Dead extend the reading to the value-form as operator derivation and to general intellect.
pages.note: Stray kept in place: PRED-890.H1 (academic study of magic).
